name: slidemind
description: A focused desktop workspace for shaping presentation ideas.
author: SlideMind

scripts.test: vitest run && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.web.json && node scripts/test-renderer.mjs
scripts.package: tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.node.json && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.web.json && node scripts/typecheck-pptist.cjs && pnpm test && electron-vite build && node scripts/tika-package/prepare.mjs && electron-builder && node scripts/tika-package/verify.mjs
scripts.package:mac: tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.node.json && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.web.json && node scripts/typecheck-pptist.cjs && pnpm test && electron-vite build && node scripts/tika-package/prepare.mjs --platforms darwin-x64,darwin-arm64 && CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY=false electron-builder --mac --x64 --arm64 && node scripts/tika-package/verify.mjs --platforms darwin-x64,darwin-arm64
scripts.package:win: tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.node.json && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.web.json && node scripts/typecheck-pptist.cjs && pnpm test && electron-vite build && node scripts/tika-package/prepare.mjs --platforms win32-x64 && electron-builder --win --x64 && node scripts/tika-package/verify.mjs --platforms win32-x64
